documents.title: Critical edition introduction
documents.text:
Critical edition introduction — Tellmar Fragments (fictional).
In this document "TF-MS" means Tellmar Fragments. Tellmar Fragments reports radiocarbon median date (CE) of 849 year for FY2025. Tellmar Fragments reports quire count of 7 for FY2025. Tellmar Fragments reports number of scribal hands of 4 for LTM to 30 Jun 2025. Tellmar AB reports folio count of 61 for FY2024. The fiscal year of Tellmar Fragments ends on 30 June.

documents.title: Catalogue entry
documents.text:
Catalogue entry — Tellmar Fragments (fictional).
Tellmar Fragments reports c14 median of 957 year for FY2025. Tellmar Fragments reports quire count of 6 for FY2025. Tellmar Fragments reports line count of 34 for FY2024. Tellmar Fragments reports recorded variant readings of 2000 for FY2024.

documents.title: Review article
documents.text:
Review article — Tellmar Fragments (fictional).
Tellmar Fragments reports number of scribal hands of 5 for FY2025 (fiscal year ending 30 June 2025). Tellmar Ltd reports folio count of 68 for FY2024. Tellmar Fragments reports approximately line count of 33 for FY2024. Tellmar Fragments reports recorded variant readings of 1580 for FY2024. "c14 median" has the same meaning as "radiocarbon median".
